title: Around the World in Eighty Days · the wager excerpt

transcript:
It is time to relate what a change took place in English public opinion when it transpired that the real bankrobber, a certain James Strand, had been arrested, on the 17th day of December, at Edinburgh. Three days before, Phileas Fogg had been a criminal, who was being desperately followed up by the police; now he was an honourable gentleman, mathematically pursuing his eccentric journey round the world.
The papers resumed their discussion about the wager; all those who had laid bets, for or against him, revived their interest, as if by magic; the "Phileas Fogg bonds" again became negotiable, and many new wagers were made. Phileas Fogg's name was once more at a premium on 'Change.
His five friends of the Reform Club passed these three days in a state of feverish suspense. Would Phileas Fogg, whom they had forgotten, reappear before their eyes! Where was he at this moment? The 17th of December, the day of James Strand's arrest, was the seventy-sixth since Phileas Fogg's departure, and no news of him had been received. Was he dead? Had he abandoned the effort, or was he continuing his journey along the route agreed upon? And would he appear on Saturday, the 21st of December, at a quarter before nine in the evening, on the threshold of the Reform Club saloon?

questions.prompt: What caused public opinion about Fogg to change?
options: The actual bank robber was arrested.
answers: The actual bank robber was arrested.
questions.evidence: the real bankrobber, a certain James Strand, had been arrested
questions.explanation: 抓住真正罪犯使公众不再把 Fogg 当作罪犯，不能把此前怀疑当成定罪事实。

questions.prompt: In which city was James Strand arrested? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: on the 17th day of December, at Edinburgh.
questions.explanation: Edinburgh 是逮捕地点；Reform Club 是等候 Fogg 的场所。

questions.prompt: What happened to interest in the wager?
options: It was limited to the police.
It revived and new bets were placed.
answers: It revived and new bets were placed.
questions.evidence: revived their interest, as if by magic
questions.explanation: revived 与 new wagers 表示重新活跃；并未只限警察。

questions.prompt: How many Reform Club friends were waiting anxiously? Write ONE WORD.
questions.evidence: His five friends of the Reform Club passed these three days in a state of feverish suspense.
questions.explanation: five 是朋友人数；three 是持续天数。

questions.prompt: What was known about Fogg’s whereabouts at that point?
options: He had sent his friends a daily message.
He had already returned to the club.
No news of him had arrived.
answers: No news of him had arrived.
questions.evidence: no news of him had been received.
questions.explanation: 后面的生死及是否继续旅行都是疑问，并非确定消息；也没有证实他已返回俱乐部。

questions.prompt: At what time on 21 December was Fogg expected at the club?
questions.evidence: at a quarter before nine in the evening
questions.explanation: a quarter before nine 是晚上8:45；before 不可听成 after。
